reference_discrepancies.observation: Pinned compiler allocates Array before evaluating initializer(): negative size skips the factory; zero size evaluates it once, producing event9.
reference_discrepancies.interpretation: The specification describes an inline Array constructor and ordinary call arguments evaluated left-to-right before invocation. Whether the special inline constructor permits earlier allocation needs clarification; this report does not resolve the discrepancy.
reference_discrepancies.resolution: Effectful initializer-producing expressions are explicitly unsupported. Recorded positive array support covers literal lambdas at fixed nonnegative sizes; no broader runtime-order claim.
